Another defeat will increase the pressure on the Blues. But Friday offers a perfect chance for Alonso's side to end the month with a win and give them a much-needed confidence lift as they head into a challenging December.

Here are all the details you need ahead of Friday's Premier League clash against Nottingham Forest.

Date: Friday 27th November 2026

Kick-off time: 20:00 (UK)

Stadium: City Ground, Nottingham [...] Chelsea remain without Reece James, Maxence Lacroix and Joao Pedro for the trip to Nottingham.

Alonso remained coy about when Lacroix and Joao Pedro could return, but Chelsea have received a huge boost. Moises Caicedo is fit and available for Friday's fixture despite coming off injured against Leeds. [...] Emmanuel Emegha will be desperate to lead the line after scoring in the defeat to Leeds United. Estevao Willian and Pedro Neto will be vying for minutes, with Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer likely to start at the City Ground.

Jamie Gittens returned to training this week, but it remains unclear where he is on his road to recovery.
